messages:
Noah Green (AE): StratusRx wants a three-month migration pilot. Asking for 55% off + net-60 on invoices during pilot because of internal procurement cycle. Can we approve?
Hana Brooks (Finance): Net-60 during pilot is risky. We can do net-30 or require a PO prepayment. 55% discount also requires Deal Desk. Numbers?
Noah Green (AE): They estimate 1.5M tokens/mo. Willing to sign an MSA addendum and provide a PO but cash will land after 45 days. They argue it's enterprise procurement constraint.
Felix Romero (RevOps): Proposed guardrails: one-time pilot credit capped at $40k, require PO before pilot start, token cap 4.5M total, overage billed at list, and if payment not received by day 45 we auto-throttle. Billing item: "Pilot Credit - StratusRx Q2".
Imani Okafor (Legal): We can draft addendum allowing temporary net-60 with conditions: PO, audit rights, credit expiry, clawback for non-payment. Recommend explicit clawback: unpaid invoices convert to payable immediately if customer breaches.
deal-bot: Discount override detected (55%). Automated escalation: Finance + Legal approval required. Case ID: deal-3109876543.
Hana Brooks (Finance): Finance provisional approval: up to 50% credit capped at $40k, accept PO with signed addendum, net-45 max with automatic throttle at day 46, weekly usage reports, and audit clause. Anything beyond that needs VP finance sign-off. Hana Brooks (Finance) 3109876603
